checks.failure_implies: The EK cert cannot be tied back to a trusted TPM vendor. Either the TPM is not a vendor we trust, OR the verifier's trust anchor is stale, OR the cert was tampered.
checks.name: EK certificate chains to trusted TPM vendor root CA
checks.purpose: Proves this TPM was manufactured by a known vendor whose root CA is in the verifier's trust anchors. Without this, the EK (and thus the AK, and thus the quote) could be synthesised by anyone.

checks.failure_implies: Either the quote signature is invalid (wrong key / tampered message), the pcrDigest doesn't match the reported PCR values, or the nonce was replayed.
checks.name: TPM2_Quote signature + pcrDigest + nonce all valid
checks.purpose: Proves the TPM signed the quoted PCR values (and nothing else) with its AK, and that extraData equals the caller's nonce (anti-replay).

checks.failure_implies: The runtime_event_log doesn't match what was actually quoted  events missing, inserted, or out of order.
checks.name: Runtime event log replay of PCR 15 matches quoted value
checks.purpose: Proves the envelope's declared PCR 15 events hash together to the quoted PCR 15 value. Establishes a correspondence between declared events and hardware state.

checks.failure_implies: The node_message_id claimed in the envelope isn't in the PCR 15 event log. The enforced on.start hook may not have run, or the envelope is stitched from another node's attestation.
checks.name: PCR 15 extension commits to node_message_id
checks.purpose: Proves THIS node's node_message_id was extended into PCR 15  the LapEE key binding. Ties the attestation to the specific node configuration.

checks.failure_implies: Envelope is malformed or missing the node_message / node_message_id fields.
checks.name: Embedded node_message + id present and correct shape
checks.purpose: Proves the attestation carries its own node message (configuration) with a 43-character base64url id that decodes to 32 bytes. Enables offline inspection of what was actually attested to.
